title: Stakeholder Perspectives on Whether and How Social Robots Can Support Mediation and Advocacy for Higher Education Students with Disabilities

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of interviews and participatory co-design focus groups with disabled students and practitioners to evaluate concerns about systemic ableism, neuronormativity, and the double empathy problem in social robots and AI.

Thematic analysis of stakeholder discussions and quantitative Mentimeter surveys capturing concerns about how AI systems perpetuate biases against marginalized groups (people of color, trans, and queer individuals) due to homogenous design perspectives.
